settings.title: White makes it crisp.
settings.text: Black and white is the cleanest high-contrast setup. Use it when you want sharp without looking loud.

settings.title: Red gives it a tour signal.
settings.text: Use red as a small hit on markers, towels, or details. Keep it controlled.

settings.title: Gold adds polish.
settings.text: Gold works best as a quiet premium accent, not a dominant color.

settings.title: Start black
settings.text: Let the bag stay visually heavy and modern.

settings.title: Pick one contrast
settings.text: White, red, or gold should be repeated across the visible pieces.

settings.title: Avoid extra noise
settings.text: Black can handle contrast, but too many accents weaken the premium look.

settings.heading: Build around a black bag.
settings.subheading: Black is the easiest base for a sharp Built Birdie setup. Keep the accent clear and let the contrast do the work.
